notes.title: Steam Deck Hotfix v1.1.0.4.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

This small hotfix finally fixes that pesky black screen bug that was occurring on Steam Deck. 

What caused this bug?
For some odd reason, having the Window setting set to "Fullscreen" caused the game to crash sometimes on Steam Deck'. However, keeping the setting on "Windowed" fixes this, so I've defaulted this setting on Steam Deck. Please note there aren't any visual changes from this!

Thanks to everyone who helped me troubleshoot this issue over the past few months. It was a huge help! If you happen to find any other issues, please report them in the Steam Discussions or drop a bug report in the Discord <3

Discord Link: https://discord.gg/Qb6WMmpFJR

notes.title: Free Content Update AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
[h3]The free content update for Smushi Come Home is available NOW! There's one last adventure to embark on now that Smushi made it back home...[/h3]

This update adds brand new [b]post-game content[/b] to Smushi! Travel to new areas and help restore the Heart of the Forest. The forest helped you find your way home, so surely you can return the favor and help the forest... right?

[previewyoutube=QpLC72jzfrM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Abbreviated Patch Notes:[/h2]
[h3]New content[/h3]
* 2 New mini areas
* 1 New main area
* 5 New skins to unlock
* 6 New mushrooms to discover
* 3 New achievements to unlock
* 1 New secret upgrade
* 2 New speedrunner modes
* New music
* New items
* New mechanics
* New NPCs

[h3]Fixes & Improvements[/h3]
* Loads of minor and major bug fixes
* Camera improvements to not collide as much with environment

[h3]Other Notes About Update[/h3]
* The update is fully compatible with older saves
* You can start the new content by [spoiler]talking to the capybara in the Lake of Bloom level[/spoiler]
* This update will remove two of your achievements if you unlocked them before (Modified Mushroom and A True Mycologist) since there are new skins and mushrooms added to the game.

If you happen to find any bugs, please report them in our Discord server! https://discord.gg/Qb6WMmpFJR


I truly hope you all enjoy playing the new content. I've been working on it for some time now since the game's release and it's been a lot of fun adding new mechanics and collectables! I always wanted to do a free update like this if the initial release went well, and thankfully it did so here we are now! Again, thank you all so so much for supporting my game and helping me make this dream a reality. I still can't believe how much the game resonated with you all. I'm beyond grateful and happy to see players from all over the world bringing Smushi home <3

- SomeHumbleOnion & Mooneye

notes.title: Smushi Plushie and Content Update News!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! It's been a while since I've posted an announcement but I promise this is a good one.

Thanks to all your support, we've finally released a plushie of Smushi!!! SMUSHI PLUSHI!! This wouldn't be possible without yall, so thank you so much! The plushies are available on Makeship right now for a limited time, so grab one while you can using the link below!

https://www.makeship.com/products/smushi-plush

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259975/144b5645e66ac5c7d3b716ebb1ffe5101c111efa.png[/img]

I'm also super excited to announce the free upcoming content update!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259975/5703f55d71ad22aa4d2310994cf7ca31eab933f6.png[/img]

It's been really awesome getting to make more content for Smushi. I always had plans to do a free update like this if the game was successful enough, and here we are today making it happen!

This update includes 1 new level to explore (along with a few side levels). There's new NPCs to meet, skins to collect, mushrooms to discover, and more! You'll be able to access this new content once you've beaten the main game and it'll work with your old saves. I won't spoil too much right now, but look forward to a trailer for this update as we get closer to its release!

Last year was absolutely insane. Quite frankly it was the craziest year of my life. Things changed dramatically after Smushi's release (for the better) and I'm so grateful for all your support. Making games is my passion, and Smushi was truly a dream game that I wanted to fulfill. Now we've got plushies, a content update coming soon, potentially even some physical releases for the Switch! I'm so blown away by all the support. Thank you for playing my game, and I hope to see you return when the update comes around!

- SomeHumbleOnion <3

With this mode enabled, you'll be able to run through the game much quicker since it auto-skips dialogue, auto-skips major cutscenes, and has an in-game timer that ends once you've reached the credits!

Feel free to join our Speedrunner community in the official Smushi Come Home server, where you can chat about strategies and techniques!

https://discord.gg/Qb6WMmpFJR

With that, have funs running through the game and beeting that highscore and have a great weekend! 😊

notes.title: Small Hotfix version 1.0.5.1
notes.content:
With the hotfix 1.0.5.1 we're fixing:

[list]
[*] UI glitch when crafting skins
[*] getting stuck on capybara during sibling questline
[/list]

We also heard from some of you that the game was flagged by your anti virus software. If that happened, it was most likely a false positive as described by Steam here: https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/5F3D-1477-AFF9-C4F3 as Steam applications are scanned by Steam anyway.

We did use the official Steam wrapper for our launcher which might have been the issue as some new virus probably behaves similar to Steam and was therefore flagged. For this version we have not used the Steam wrapper and just used the normal Unity application. If you had issues with your virus software before, please try again now and report back to us if it's now working or not! In the meantime we will send the application to some anti-virus vendors to be verified and added to their whitelist, which would be an easy fix for future versions, but we're not sure how long that could take!

Until then, we hope that you continue enjoying the game! :)

Your Mooneyes and SomeHumbleOnion

notes.title: Little Mushroom Gets New Name - Smushi Come Home
notes.content:
Hey mushroom family,

My publishers and I were recently hit with a Cease & Desist order, demanding we change the name of my character and game title. It's been a difficult week or so since this happened, but unfortunately due to legal reasons I must make these name changes. This didn't come easy to me, given how close we are to release and how attached I am to this character, but the decision isn't mine or my publisher's to make anymore 

I've decided to rename my character to Smushi (pronounced Smush-y), making the new title of my game Smushi Come Home. It was a difficult decision to make since all I want to bring people happiness and joy and my character is a big part of that. But I hope you come to like the new name just as much as I already have and I'm really looking forward to everyone finally playing!

Thank you all so much for the continued support. Making this game has been the most difficult thing I've ever done in my life, yet it's been immensely rewarding and I wouldn't want to be doing anything else. Seeing people of all ages across the world be excited for my little game brings me more joy than you can imagine and I feel truly blessed. Rest assured, Smushi Come Home is coming out very soon and I hope you're still as excited as I am for its release! <3

Cheers,
Your Moonies and SomeHumbleOnion
